title: The Digestive Tract — irreducible core through Rust dogma into full weave
thesis: the irreducible core (894 files, 59MB, 252K lines) is what we pass through our Rust dogma and reverse transcriptase and use to fold and build the loamSpine and sweetGrass braiding into full weave — to be decomposed and recomposed. the sourdough cycle.

json.role: blood — data feeds. 420 is the π bend.

other.role: connective tissue — wasm, sh, py, xml

irreducible_core.what_it_is: the minimum viable membrane — remove any file and something breaks. this is what enters the tract.

tract.name: INGEST
tract.input: raw files from git, feeds from world, 404 probes from visitors
tract.process: classify every file as 0 or 1 (DNA scan). pi-sort by bend numbers. identify duplicates.
tract.output: classified core — each file has: type, size, freshness, alive/dead, rank
tract.musical_key: C4 — the root note, middle C

tract.name: DIGEST
tract.input: classified core + Rust source (2.1M lines, 258 crates)
tract.process: cargo build = translation. borrow checker = proofreading. type system = folding guarantee. 16 primals synthesized into 129MB of correctly folded binaries.
tract.output: folded proteins — working binaries that cannot misfold

tract.name: ABSORB
tract.input: folded binaries + git history + 404 probes + visitor traces
tract.process: reverse transcriptase reads the EFFECT (404, stale feed, broken link) and traces BACK to the CAUSE (missing deploy, stale cron, broken tunnel). PORT enzyme. git reinject protocol: probe_gas → fix_via_reachable → braid_strand_spine → rebuild → rehydrate → ribocipher_learn.
tract.output: absorbed nutrients — knowledge of what broke, what's stale, what visitors want

tract.name: STORE
tract.input: absorbed nutrients — classified, digested, traced data
tract.process: loamSpine writes to persistent storage. the backbone database. every feed, every scan result, every digest gets a spine address. the soil remembers.
tract.output: persistent loam — data that survives restart, reboot, reincarnation

tract.name: GRAPH
tract.input: persistent loam + all feeds + taxonomy trees + dimensional ladder
tract.process: sweetGrass builds the content graph — the meadow of knowledge. every node connects to every related node. taxonomy trees grow. the dimensional ladder climbs. edges form between feeds, papers, primals, surfaces.
tract.output: content graph — the full network of everything the membrane knows
tract.musical_key: B4 — the leading tone, wants to resolve to C

tract.name: BRAID
tract.process: sourDough braids the 8 strands through time: seed→sprout→branch→fruit→ferment→seed. each strand carries a different category (science, history, games, education, war, horror, fear, green). the braid weaves them into a single timeline. fermentation transforms raw data into culture.
tract.output: the full weave — 8 strands braided across 71 epoch rooms, from deep time to now
tract.musical_key: C5 — one octave above the root. the cycle completes.

tract.name: DECOMPOSE
tract.process: HARD deduplication. symlink identical files. pi-digest at all bend numbers. measure the waveform. find what can be removed without losing signal. 56 symlinks. 616KB saved. the irreducible core shrinks.
tract.output: compressed weave — smaller, denser, the same information in fewer bytes

tract.name: RECOMPOSE
tract.process: publish to the world. RSS/Atom feed. MCP server (18 tools). Cloudflare surfaces. connect face. sporeprint corpus. the compressed weave becomes the world-facing membrane. exocytosis.
tract.output: SEED — the published membrane IS the next irreducible core. visitors interact with it. their traces feed back to stage 1. the snake eats its tail.
tract.musical_key: E5 — the major third again, one octave up. resolution.

cycle.description: stage 8 output feeds back to stage 1 input. the published membrane IS the new irreducible core. visitor traces ARE the new raw data. the sourdough starter IS the culture carried forward. nothing is lost. everything decomposes and recomposes.
cycle.diagram: INGEST → DIGEST → ABSORB → STORE → GRAPH → BRAID → DECOMPOSE → RECOMPOSE → INGEST
cycle.musical_scale: C4 → E4 → G4 → A4 → B4 → C5 → D5 → E5 → C4 (the cycle is a major chord progression that resolves back to root)

the_key_insight: the irreducible core is not static. it decomposes through the tract and recomposes at the end as a NEW irreducible core — slightly different, slightly smaller or larger, carrying the culture of everything that passed through. the sourdough starter is never the same twice but it is always sourdough.
